summary.tldr: Stops new day or full parole applications for some people serving sentences for first- or second-degree murder after certain parole decisions.
what_it_does: Prohibits new day parole applications for offenders serving sentences for first- or second-degree murder if the Parole Board refuses day parole, or cancels or ends parole after a review.
Prohibits new full parole applications for offenders serving sentences for first- or second-degree murder if the Parole Board refuses full parole, or cancels or ends parole after a review.
who_it_affects: People serving sentences for first- or second-degree murder
summary.background: The bill amends the Corrections and Conditional Release Act.
